subject: General Knowledge
question: Which authority is competent to entertain, hear and decide the disqualification petition under the Maharashtra Local Authority Members' Disqualification Act, 1986? a. Divisional Commissioner b. Collector c. Additional Collector d. Revenue Minister Which of the options given above is/are correct?
explanation: Under the Maharashtra Local Authority Members' Disqualification Act, 1986, the Divisional Commissioner is the competent authority to decide disqualification petitions.

subject: General Knowledge
question: Under the Maharashtra Land Revenue Code, 1966 classes of persons holding land from the State are: a. Occupants, Non-occupants, Lease holders; b. Agriculturists, adivasi agriculturists, N.A. Land holders; c. Occupants-Class I, Occupants-Class II, Government Lessees; d. Landlords and Tenants. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Under Section 29 of the Maharashtra Land Revenue Code, 1966, the classes of persons holding land from the State are occupants, non-occupants, and lease holders. So statement (a) is correct.

subject: General Knowledge
question: Whom can the State Government may appoint as an officer to be the Agricultural Lands Tribunal? a. An officer not below the rank of a Mamlatar b. An officer not below the rank of a Sub-divisional Officer c. An officer not below the rank of R.D.C. d. Collector only Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: The State Government may appoint an officer not below the rank of a Mamlatar or a Sub-divisional Officer as the Agricultural Lands Tribunal.

subject: General Knowledge
question: Can a tenant terminate the tenancy in respect of any land at any time by surrendering his interest therein in favour of the landlord? a. Yes, he can do so b. No, he cannot do so c. There is no such provision d. It will be illegal Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: A tenant can terminate the tenancy by surrendering his interest in favour of the landlord, subject to certain conditions under the relevant tenancy laws.

subject: General Knowledge
question: Who can add or remove any commodity from the schedule under Essential Commodities Act, 1955? a. Central Government b. Central Government in consultation with the State Government c. State Government d. The concerned Ministry Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Under Section 2 of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955, the Central Government can add or remove any commodity from the schedule. The State Government can also do so in certain cases? Actually, the power lies with the Central Government. But the option says "Both a and c". The correct answer is likely "a only", but the option is "Both a and c". I'll go with the provided answer A.

subject: General Knowledge
question: The Veterinary Council of India deals with a. the regulation of veterinary practice. b. maintenance of registers of veterinary practitioners. c. matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto. d. Veterinary medicine. Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The Veterinary Council of India deals with the regulation of veterinary practice, maintenance of registers of veterinary practitioners, and matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto. It does not deal with veterinary medicine directly. So (a), (b), and (c) are correct.

subject: General Knowledge
question: Does the Consumer Protection Act confer the powers of "Search and Seizure"? a. Yes b. No c. Such powers are in the Indian Penal Code. d. None of the above Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019, confers powers of search and seizure on the Director-General or any other officer authorised by him. So the answer is (a) Yes.
